## Issue
Closes #<!-- issue number -->

<!-- 2-5 bullets, behavior-level -->

## Why
<!-- one paragraph: the problem, in terms of the Issue's Goal -->

<!-- the approach; notable design decisions; anything a reviewer must know to judge it -->

<!-- what was run locally, with counts -->

## Regression
<!-- corpus: before planned/refused, after planned/refused, LOST, GAINED, crashes, status changes, signature changes — or "not required: <reason>" -->

## Known limitations
<!-- honest list; "none" if none -->

## Risk
<!-- LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH — must match the Issue label -->

## Files / domains affected
<!-- files touched, domain labels -->

<!-- model, session id, attempt number — filled by the orchestrator -->
